chunks: By this chain of narration, it was said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
The stars are a safeguard for the people of the heavens, and the members of my Household are a safeguard for my nation.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Ahl al-Bayt as a safeguard for the Muslim community according to Hadith?
ai.summary: This famous hadith, known as 'Hadith al-Nujum', establishes the Ahl al-Bayt as the terrestrial counterpart to the stars, emphasizing their role as a divine safeguard against deviation for the Muslim Ummah. In Shia scholarship, this analogy underscores the necessity of following the Imams for spiritual stability, mirroring how the stars prevent chaos in the heavens. The reference to 'Ahl al-Bayt' specifically highlights the infallible Imams as the enduring source of guidance after the Prophet.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-14 According to the same documentation, God’s Prophet (S) said, “
The stars are the safeguards for the residents of the heavens, and the members of my Household are the safeguards for my nation.”
